sources.title: qvac/TranslatePsy-AfriSLM-0.8B-Q4-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: TranslatePsy-AfriSLM-.8B-Q4-GGUF is the Q4_K_M GGUF quantization of TranslatePsy-AfriSLM-.8B, a compact conversational machine-translation model specialized for English and 19 Sub-Saharan African languages.

sources.title: Tiny 800M AI Model Beats 122B Giant at African Translation
sources.snippet: Tether's open-source TranslatePsy-AfriSLM, at just 800M parameters, outscores Qwen3.5-122B on African translation benchmarks. The secret is data, not size.
